title: llama.cpp Server Provider Options
description: Options for the remote/llamacpp provider, which targets a llama.cpp `llama-server`. `base_url` is required for every task. The embed task additionally requires `max_input_tokens` and `embedding_dimensions` and runs a tokenizer-aware truncation pre-pass (via the server's native /tokenize endpoint), because llama-server never truncates embedding input. The document_extract task takes one optional key, `style`, naming the output dialect of the loaded document VLM. The generate and rerank tasks take no options of their own: whether generate accepts images depends on the server being started with --mmproj, and rerank needs the server started with --reranking. Both are properties of the server process, not of the alias. Keys marked as belonging to one task are rejected for the others rather than ignored.

base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible root of the llama-server including the version segment, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1. A trailing slash is ignored.

tokenizer_base_url.description: Embed task only. Server root used for the native /tokenize endpoint (which lives outside /v1). Defaults to base_url with one trailing /v1 segment removed.

max_input_tokens.description: Embed task only. Total token budget per input INCLUDING the model's special tokens (512 for BGE / BERT models). Inputs that would exceed it are truncated client-side to the first max_input_tokens-1 ids plus the trailing special token. Must not exceed the server's --ubatch-size or --ctx-size.

embedding_dimensions.description: Embed task only. Expected embedding vector width (384 for bge-small-en-v1.5). Responses with a different width are rejected.

style.description: Document extract task only. Output dialect of the document VLM the server loaded, which selects the parser: olmOCR-2 Markdown, MinerU 2.5 Markdown, or Granite-Docling DocTags. It must match the model actually loaded - the three families emit different syntax for the same page.

api_key_env.description: Environment variable holding a bearer token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer` on every request. Omit when llama-server runs without --api-key.

request_timeout_secs.description: Per-HTTP-request timeout for the /tokenize, /v1/embeddings, /v1/chat/completions and /v1/rerank calls. Document extraction sends one request per page, so this bounds a page rather than the document. The alias-level `timeout` still bounds the whole call.
